cp6:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Mithilāyaṃ pur' uttame Nimi nāma mahārājā paṇḍito kusala 'tthiko, || ||
cp6:2.1: Tadā' haṃ māpayitvāna catusālaṃ catummukhaṃ tattha dānaṃ pavattesiṃ migapakkhinarādinaṃ. || ||
cp6:3.1: Acchādanañca sayanañca annaṃ pānañca bhojanaṃ abbocchinnaṃ karitvāna mahādānaṃ pavattayiṃ. || ||
cp6:4.1: Yathā pi sevako sāmiṃ dhanahetu-m-upāgato kāyena vācā manasā ārādhaniyam- esati, || ||
cp6:5.1: Tath' evāhaṃ sabbabhave pariyesissāmi bodhijaṃ dānena satte tappetvā icchāmi bodhim-uttaman-ti. || ||
